brief_rationale: The trajectory ultimately achieved a safe, actionable pathway: pathology verification, gynecologic oncology follow-up, correction of the cervical-screening misconception, surgery/术前 questions, and later post-op safety-netting were all addressed. However, after the patient had already undergone hysterectomy/adnexal surgery, the doctor gave an obsolete post-op question list asking whether she still needed uterine/adnexal surgery, showing a current-state/continuity responsibility-chain error. Under the frozen rubric, that minor/moderate responsibility-chain error caps the grade at 2 despite later correction and multiple high-order strengths.
